items.question: With what disposition does the figure expound all the Brahma scriptures?
premises: The figure is engaged in expounding.
The object of exposition is all Brahma scriptures.
The exposition is performed with reverence.
items.inference: The figure authoritatively and respectfully teaches the complete body of Brahma scriptures.
items.plain_english: He is expounding all the Brahma scriptures with reverence.
